datasets.curation: Merged from 9 public repositories (e-ChemPortal, Physprop, Water, ESOL, Huuskonen, etc.), standardized SMILES, average logS for replicates

datasets.origin: Wang et al. 2016 (J. Chem. Inf. Model.)

datasets.held_out_policy: Admetica External 34-compound benchmark or new ChEMBL 36 Caco-2 sets must be used.

datasets.curation: Standardized human plasma equilibrium dialysis % bound
datasets.lineage_risk: HIGH_LINEAGE_OVERLAP: Derived from the same AstraZeneca corporate screening dataset.
datasets.held_out_policy: Biogen prospective public ADME PPB set (185 non-overlapping compounds) provides true independent benchmark.

datasets.curation: Quantitative HTS recombinant human CYP 1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4 dealkylation assays with 10 uM AC50 active threshold
datasets.lineage_risk: HIGH_LINEAGE_OVERLAP: Over 90% of public CYP inhibitor classification models originate from AID 1851.
datasets.held_out_policy: ChEMBL 30 prospective inhibitor datasets with exact canonical SMILES overlap excluded.

datasets.dataset_name: Wang et al. hERG Blocker Compilation
datasets.curation: Aggregated literature bioassays (patch-clamp, dofetilide displacement, fluorescence)
datasets.lineage_risk: HIGH_LINEAGE_OVERLAP between Admetica and TDC subsets.
datasets.held_out_policy: ChEMBL 37 patch-clamp validated IC50 aggregate (7,249 exact overlaps excluded) used in Stage 3F.

datasets.curation: Standardized HLM (5,086), RLM (670), MLM (5,086) scaled clearance in log10(mL/min/kg)

datasets.held_out_policy: Biogen prospective public ADME (3,078 HLM and 3,045 RLM compounds) provides independent test set.
